high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page featuring a post by the account "physicsmindset." The post includes a visually striking image of a cosmic scene, depicting a curved structure that resembles a tunnel or wormhole, with a bright light at one end and a starry background suggesting a view into space. The text accompanying the image reads: "About 13.7 billion years ago you were directly related to the universe and still is." This statement is likely a play on the Big Bang theory, which posits that the universe began as a singularity about 13.
